info.name: Microsoft Graph Admin Admin.admin chats.chatMessage API
chats.chatMessage
Microsoft Graph List messages in a chat

params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Retrieve the list of messages in a chat. This method supports federation. To list chat messages in application context, the request must be made from the tenant that the channel owner belongs to (represented by the tenantId property on the channel).

info.name: Microsoft Graph Send message in a chat

items.docs: Send a new chatMessage in the specified chat. This API can't create a new chat; you must use the list chats method to retrieve the ID of an existing chat before you can create a chat message.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Get chatMessage in a channel or chat

items.docs: Retrieve a single message or a message reply in a channel or a chat.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke function delta

params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Get the list of messages from all chats in which a user is a participant, including one-on-one chats, group chats, and meeting chats. When you use delta query, you can get new or updated messages. To get the replies for a message, use the list message replies or the get message reply operations. A GET request with the delta function returns one of the following: State tokens are opaque to the client. To proceed with a round of change tracking, copy and apply the @odata.nextLink or @odata.deltaLi
